**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep expired watches out of reopen updates**

When a repository has any eligible recently closed watch, this update revives every closed watch whose number appears in the open-PR listing. Consequently, a PR reopened after the documented seven-day window is silently re-registered whenever another PR in the same repository closed recently, potentially resuming polling and notifications to an old session. Add the same `closed_at` window and paused/merged eligibility predicates used by the repository query to this update.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Charge the quota for every paginated reopen request**

For repositories with more than 100 open PRs, this reserves only one REST call before `github.open_pulls()` invokes `gh api --paginate`. The inspected `gh api --help` explicitly states that pagination makes additional HTTP requests to fetch all pages, so this operation can cross the configured quota reserve by one call per additional page -- the boundary this release is intended to preserve. Account for all pages or avoid fetching pages once the remaining budget is exhausted.
